infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Super App lets you attach photos from your library to share with your assistant.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Super App can save images your assistant produces to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Super App can take a photo to share with your assistant.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Super App uses the microphone so you can talk to your assistant.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Super App transcribes your voice so your assistant can respond.

plugins.microphonePermission: Your agent listens while you talk to it.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Your spoken words are transcribed on this device.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Super App reads your Health data so your assistant can answer questions about your activity, sleep, and workouts. It syncs only to your own private agent.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Super App does not write to Health today; this permission is reserved for saving workouts you ask your assistant to log.
